_comment: Canonical cross-app contract for the security/audit event log and the shared account-lockout policy (ADR-012). Both applications WRITE security_events, and both enforce the same lockout counters on the same AdminUser fields — a lockout enforced by only one app is not a lockout, because the attacker simply uses the other. Asserted from server/test/security-event-contract.test.js and test/security-event-contract.test.ts. Test-time-only fixture; never imported by production code.
